Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: The clears tab is three lists now - First clears, Savage and Ultimates - because a first clear happens once and an Ultimate reclear happens most evenings, and mixed together the second buried the first. Savage reclears are recorded on their own list. Cards lead with the player's own portrait instead of the same boss eight times, and clicking a face or a name opens that person's profile. The rating window after a duty now waits to find out who it can actually take a vote on, instead of offering everybody and holding the ones that did not count. Fixed clear announcements reaching some people and not others - the plugin was tracking the feed by when clears happened rather than when they were posted, and those are not the same order, so a clear posted late was dropped for good on whichever clients had already read past it. Announcements now also arrive at the same time for everybody instead of up to two minutes apart. Fixed "Show names as" being ignored on the clears cards, auto-adjust rewriting a listing into a composition nobody asked for when somebody left, and "You can still rate these" counting people who were no longer on screen.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: DutyDM
Description: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Punchline: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Changelog: Party-full alerts now only fire when the last seat fills while you wait (7 -> 8), and are blocked for 30 seconds after leaving a duty. Joining an already-full PF or re-forming after an instance no longer sends a redundant notification.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: AutoRezzer
Description:
Raises dead players around you, and accepts raises cast on you.

Requires Rotation Solver Reborn - add the Combat Reborn repository:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FFXIV-CombatReborn/CombatRebornRepo/main/pluginmaster.json

One switch. Anyone in range who needs a raise gets one, Swiftcast first. In Occult Crescent it uses Occult Raise or Revive instead, which work on any job. It pauses your rotation only when a rez is genuinely about to happen, then puts it back exactly as it was. Four switches decide where it works: open world and FATEs, instanced duties, Eureka and Bozja, and the Crescent.

Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Punchline: Raises everyone around you, and accepts your own. Built for Occult Crescent and FATEs.
Changelog: A new window, and a lot fewer settings. It looks like a phone app now, with a card at the top that tells you what job is rezzing, what it is doing, and why it is not. Ten settings are gone because each had one right answer: rezzing strangers, Swiftcast, the whole Rotation Solver tab and the Red Mage toggle all just happen now. Where it rezzes is four switches: open world, duties, field operations, sanctuaries. New: hold the rez prompt before answering it, Thin Air to rez on an empty MP bar, Lucid Dreaming when low MP is the problem, and the game's own phantom job pixel art in the Crescent. If no job on your character can rez, the rezzing half of the window hides itself and leaves you the half that works on every job.
